title: "Simulations"

The simulation page has been split. The benchmarks are now:

- [Simulation 1: Hidden coherence across distinct proteins](simulation_funfam.html):
  a controlled positive benchmark on CATH FunFam domains.
- [Simulation 2: Sequence-disjoint functional contrasts](simulation_ec.html):
  enzyme classes carried by different sequence clusters in every sample, and
  how the MCL bins group the same enzymes.
- [MCL parameters](parameters.html): how the graph thresholds and inflation
  shape the bins.
